additionalProperties.description: Sizes by pane path: `sidebar` is [width]; a split is its view key and child indices (`default`, `default.1`, `changes.0.0`; a switch adds `case<n>` or `otherwise`), with one size in points per pane along the split axis. expanded.description: Starts expanded (default: true, but a section with more than 20 items starts collapsed). Clicking its header expands or collapses it, and the window remembers that.
